lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters localized on the right-most visible portion of the dark epidermal region, oriented in roughly vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the circular high-luminance nodes to form a repetitive lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Pronounced horizontal linear feature running across the upper boundary of the dark flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient between light-saturated pixels above and shadowed pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense school of high-luminance biomass (smaller fish) in the foreground causing significant occlusion of the ventral-lateral flank region.
